# Workspace Governance

Symbolic links (using **relative paths**) to the centralized governance repository (diceman175-governator). 14 links total: 8 directory links under `governator/` and 6 file links at the repo root.

## governator/ directory links

- **audit** - Audit and validation scripts
- **orchestrate** - Orchestration and automation workflows
- **permissions** - AI automation and CI/CD permissions
- **procedures** - Standard operating procedures and runbooks
- **schemas** - Metadata schemas and governed types
- **scripts** - Governance and automation scripts
- **standards** - Naming, encoding, version, and other standards
- **templates** - File templates for code, markdown, etc.

## Repo-root file links

- **metadata-tags.yaml** - Controlled vocabulary of A6 tags
- **metadata-fields.yaml** - Schema 2.1 metadata field definitions
- **AI-AUTOMATION-PERMISSIONS.md** - AI agent permission policy
- **WORKSPACE-NAMING-STANDARD.md** - Kebab-case and naming convention standard
- **WORKSPACE-ENCODING-STANDARD.md** - UTF-8 and CRLF/LF encoding standard
- **WORKSPACE-VERSION-STANDARD.md** - .version file and semantic versioning standard

## Symlink Details

Directory links use `../../diceman175-governator/symlink-src/{subfolder}` (two levels up, from `governator/`).
Root file links use `../diceman175-governator/symlink-src/{path}` (one level up, from the repo root).
All targets are relative for portability across machines and directory relocations.

See [SYMLINKS.md](./SYMLINKS.md) for the detailed manifest.
